$comment: Unicorn rig config for rive-mcp (rive-mcp docs/rigging-playbook.md). Carries only what the contract cannot know: the art's hierarchy, draw order, origin and palette binding. The clip table, event ticks and inputs all derive from assets/manifest.json rigContract via --contract --set hero, so the tick numbers are never restated here — restating is where the off-by-one gets in. One config covers all four tiers; joints are measured per tier from that tier's own alpha overlaps. PALETTE: mane rides the mane part on every species. Accent rides the horn — the signature part, as paletteRule says.
